helpers.name: get_admin_permission_context
helpers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_admin_permission_context(_session_token text)
 RETURNS TABLE(role_code text, role_label text, permission_codes text[])
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  _admin_id uuid;
begin
  select vat.admin_id into _admin_id
  from public.validate_admin_session_token(_session_token) vat
  limit 1;

  if _admin_id is null then
    raise exception 'Admin account is not authorized.';
  end if;

  return query
  select r.code::text, r.label, r.permission_codes
  from public.admin_accounts a
  join public.roles r on r.id = a.role_id
  where a.id = _admin_id;
end;
$function$

helpers.name: current_user_is_admin
helpers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_user_is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select public.current_user_has_any_role(array['admin']::public.app_role_code[]);
$function$

helpers.name: validate_admin_session_token
helpers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_admin_session_token(_session_token text)
 RETURNS TABLE(admin_id uuid, username citext, email citext, display_name text, expires_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update public.admin_sessions
  set last_used_at = now()
  where token_hash = encode(extensions.digest(_session_token, 'sha256'), 'hex')
    and revoked_at is null
    and public.admin_sessions.expires_at > now();

  return query
  select
    aa.id,
    aa.username,
    aa.email,
    aa.display_name,
    s.expires_at
  from public.admin_sessions s
  join public.admin_accounts aa on aa.id = s.admin_id
  where s.token_hash = encode(extensions.digest(_session_token, 'sha256'), 'hex')
    and s.revoked_at is null
    and s.expires_at > now()
    and aa.is_active = true
  limit 1;
end;
$function$
